# HX-UI 2

> React 19 + TypeScript 界面库. 基于 shadcn/ui (Radix + Tailwind v4), 动效用 Motion, 图表用 Recharts, 表格用 TanStack Table v8. 路径别名 "@/" 指向 src.

分三层:
- UI 组件: 做产品用的基础件, 从 `@/components/ui/<name>` 引 (与 shadcn 用法一致). 特效只是它们的参数.
- 视觉组件: 能撑起一屏主视觉的效果 (`@/text/*`, `@/effects/tilt-card`).
- 落地页: 整页成品 (筹备中).

## UI 组件
- Button(variant?: "default"|"secondary"|"outline"|"ghost"|"destructive"|"link"|"shimmer", size?, asChild?): shimmer 是品牌色底加扫光, 一页最多一两个
- StatefulButton(action: () => Promise, children, pendingLabel?, successLabel?, errorLabel?, resetAfter?, guard?, variant?, size?) from "@/interactions/stateful-button": 提交流程, 进行中禁用, 结果由读屏播报; 放进表单时传 type="submit"
- Card(effect?: "none"|"spotlight"|"beam", effectColor?) + CardHeader/CardTitle/CardDescription/CardContent/CardFooter: spotlight 指针光斑, beam 边框流光 (标出推荐项)
- Badge(variant?, dot?: "success"|"warning"|"destructive"|"info"|"muted", live?): 状态点 + 文字
- Field(label?, description?, error?, required?, disabled?, orientation?: "vertical"|"horizontal", aside?, htmlFor?) from "@/components/ui/field": 包住一个控件, 自动连好 id / aria-describedby / aria-invalid
- Input(size?: "sm"|"default"|"lg", leading?, trailing?): 框内左右放图标, 前缀, 按钮; Textarea 默认随内容长高
- SelectTrigger(size?: "sm"|"default"|"lg"); Checkbox(checked: boolean|"indeterminate"); Switch(size?); RadioGroup + RadioGroupItem | RadioGroupCard(value, title, description?, aside?)
- Slider(value: number[], thumbLabels?: string[], formatValue?: (v) => string): 两个值即区间
- ConfirmDialog(trigger?, title, description?, tone?: "default"|"destructive", confirmText?, confirmLabel?, onConfirm: () => void|Promise) from "@/components/ui/confirm-dialog": 异步提交, 失败留在原处, 输入名称确认
- Sheet + SheetContent(side?: "right"|"left"|"bottom"|"top"); toast.success/error/warning/info/promise from "sonner" (根部放 <Toaster />)
- Alert(variant?: "default"|"info"|"success"|"warning"|"destructive") + AlertTitle/AlertDescription/AlertAction
- Progress(value: number|null, size?, tone?): null 为不确定进度; Skeleton (容器加 aria-busy); Spin(variant?, size?, mode?, label?)
- DataTable(data, columns, getRowId?, searchable?, pageSize?, selectable?, bulkActions?: (rows, clear) => ReactNode, onRowClick?, density?: "default"|"compact", loading?, empty?) from "@/data"
- AreaTrend / BarCompare (data, x, series: {key,label}[], stacked?, horizontal?) ; Donut(data, center?, centerLabel?) ; Sparkline(values) from "@/data"
- ComboChart(data, x, bars, lines, stacked?, dualAxis=true, barFormatter?, lineFormatter?) ; RadarCompare(data, axis, series, grid="polygon"|"circle", max?) ; Gauge(value, min=0, max=100, label?, format?, bands?: {to,color}[], variant="arc"|"needle", sweep=240) ; ScatterBubble(groups: {key,label,points:{x,y,z?,name?}[]}[], xLabel, yLabel, zLabel?) from "@/data"
- ConversionFunnel(steps: {label,value}[], layout="bars"|"funnel", showRate=true) ; ShareTreemap(data: {name, value?, children?}[], format?) ; SankeyFlow(nodes: {name}[], links: {source,target,value}[]) ; HeatCalendar(values: Record<"YYYY-MM-DD", number>, end?, weeks=26, levels=4, unit?, label?) opens scrolled to latest week ; Candlestick(data: {t,open,high,low,close,volume?}[], scheme="cn"|"us" (cn = red up), overlay="ma"|"boll"|"none", ma=[5,10,20,60], sub="macd"|"kdj"|"rsi"|"none", showVolume=true, hollow=false, visible=90, precision=2, height=480, name?) custom SVG, crosshair, wheel zoom, drag pan, keyboard; indicators sma/ema/macd/boll/kdj/rsi exported from "@/data" ; Intraday(data: {t,price,volume?}[], prevClose, sessionLength=241, timeTicks?, scheme="cn"|"us", showAvg=true, showVolume=true) path keeps a fixed command count so push/undo/tick tween via CSS d ; DepthChart(bids: {price,size}[], asks: {price,size}[], scheme="cn"|"us" (cn = bids red), formatSize?) levels keyed by price ; VolumeProfile(bins: {price (bin floor), volume}[], price, step?, valueArea=0.7, scheme) profit/loss split at price, POC + value area; valueAreaOf() exported
- ForceGraph(nodes: {id,label?,group?,value?}[], links: {source,target,value?}[], directed=false, labels="auto"|"all"|"none", linkDistance=56, charge=-180, groups?, legend=true, onSelect?(id|null), height=420) d3-force; diffs nodes by id: kept nodes stay put, new ones grow from a neighbour, removed fade out; drag node, wheel zoom, drag pan, legend toggles groups, arrow keys walk nodes
- Waterfall(data: {label, value?, type?: "start"|"delta"|"total"}[], scheme="finance"|"cn", orientation="auto"|"vertical"|"horizontal" (auto = horizontal under 520px), showValues=true, connectors=true, unit?, format?, height=320) custom SVG; bars keyed by label, new bars grow from their step, others slide; arrow keys walk bars
- Bullet(items: {label, sub?, value, target, prior?, ranges?, max?, better?: "higher"|"lower", format?}[], rangeLabels=["差","中","好"], statusColor=true, size="md"|"sm") KPI vs target rows, role=meter; bars/target move with transform; rows keyed by label expand/collapse on add/remove
- Distribution(mode="histogram"|"box", values?: number[], groups?: {name, values}[], bins=24, markers=true (median/mean/P90), boxStrip=true, outliers=true (1.5 IQR), clip=0.99 (long tail merged into last "x+" bin), domain?, unit?, format?, height=300) histogram with box strip, or grouped box plots; bars/boxes transition on data change
- Sunburst(data: {name, value?, children?}, maxDepth=3, showLabels=true, sort=true, onDrill?(path), size=420, unit?, format?) custom SVG + d3-hierarchy partition; arcs keyed by name path and tweened (new arcs open from a gap, removed ones close); click arc drills, click center / breadcrumb goes up; keys: left/right siblings, down outer ring, Enter drill, Esc up
- Rose(data: {label, [seriesKey]: number}[], series: {key, name, color?}[], scale="area"|"radius" (area = sqrt radius, honest), innerRadius=0.16, showLabels=true, legend=true, size=440, unit?, format?) Nightingale rose, stacked series; wedges keyed by label and tweened (useArcTween); legend toggles a series layer; arrow keys walk categories
- Gantt(tasks: {id, name, start: "YYYY-MM-DD", end?, progress?: 0-1, group?, deps?: id[], milestone?}[], unit="day"|"week"|"month", today?, showDeps=true, density, maxHeight=420, onChange?(id, {start, end})) task bars + progress + dependency elbows (red dashed when start precedes predecessor end) + milestones + today line; sticky header/name column; with onChange: drag move / drag edges / keyboard ←→ and Shift+←→, snapped to days; ganttDate {toDay,toStr,add} helper
- ChinaMap(data: {name (全称/简称/adcode), value}[], mode="fill"|"bubble", classes=5, showLabels=true, southSea=true, ranking=8, selected?, onSelect?(name), metric?, unit?, format?) China province choropleth or bubble map with South China Sea inset, legend (hover a class to highlight), ranking list with layout animation; arrow keys move geographically; geo data (DataV, simplified TopoJSON ~12KB gz) lazy-loaded
- 3D (three.js + @react-three/fiber, lazy chunk, not in first-load JS; falls back to data table without WebGL; drag rotate, wheel zoom, double-click reset, keys arrows/+/-/0; autoRotate off under reduced motion): Bar3D(values: number[][], xLabels, yLabels, colorMode="value"|"row", gap=0.28, valueLabel?, format?, autoRotate=false, height=420) ; Surface3D(values: number[][], xRange, yRange, xLabel, yLabel, zLabel, format?, wireframe=true, autoRotate=false, height=440) peak label ; GlobeArcs(arcs: {from:[lat,lng], to, fromName?, toName?, value?, label?}[], points?, flow=true, autoRotate=true, focus?, height=460)
- DatePicker(value, onChange, disabledDays?) / DateRangePicker(value, onChange, presets?, months?) from "@/components/ui/date-picker"; Calendar 默认中文
- PaginationBar(page, total, pageSize?, onPageChange) from "@/components/ui/pagination"; AccordionTrigger(level?); Popover 有 PopoverTitle 时自动命名
- Tree(nodes: {id, label, textValue?, icon?, iconExpanded?, trailing?, children?, hasChildren?, disabled?, data?}[], expanded?/defaultExpanded?/onExpandedChange?, selectionMode="none"|"single"|"multiple" (default single), selected?/defaultSelected?/onSelectedChange?, checkboxes? (cascade), onAction?(node) Enter/double-click on leaf, loadChildren?(node) lazy, expandOnClick=true, lines=false, indent=16, size="sm"|"default", loading?, empty?, renderLabel?(node, state)) from "@/components/ui/tree": WAI-ARIA treeview keys (arrows, Home/End, Enter, Space, *, typeahead), roving tabindex; branchIds/subtreeIds/flattenVisible/checkState helpers
- Item(asChild?, active?, disabled?, interactive?, size="sm"|"default"|"lg", variant="default"|"outline"|"muted") + ItemTrigger(asChild?) / ItemMedia(variant="default"|"icon"|"image") / ItemContent / ItemTitle / ItemDescription(lines=1|2|3) / ItemMeta / ItemActions(reveal="hover"|"swap"|"always") / ItemSeparator(inset? follows group size) / ItemGroup(size?, variant?, highlight="static"|"slide", highlightEasing="ease"|"spring"|CSS easing, highlightDuration=220, roving?, loop=true) from "@/components/ui/item": list row (chat / mail / favorites / settings), heights 24/32/40 match Avatar; data-active; trailing actions only on hover-capable devices; ItemTrigger keeps rows with trailing buttons valid; slide = built-in FLIP highlight (no MotionProvider, scroll-safe); roving keeps exactly one tab stop (MutationObserver) and refocuses a neighbour when the focused row is removed
- Empty(size="page"|"compact", variant="default"|"outline"|"muted", animate="none"|"fade"|"rise"|"pop", duration=300, stagger=50) + EmptyMedia(variant="default"|"icon", tone) / EmptyTitle(as="h3"|h1-h6|p|div, asChild?) / EmptyDescription / EmptyContent from "@/components/ui/empty": empty / not-selected / failed state, CSS-only staggered entrance for any number of children, server-safe; pair with Skeleton while loading
- CopyField(value, copyValue?, label?, description?, size, variant="default"|"muted"|"ghost", masked?, revealed?/defaultRevealed?/onRevealedChange?, maskPeek=0, multiline?, maxHeight=160, wrap, mono=true, copiedDuration=1600, feedback="pop"|"fade"|"none", clickToCopy? (also Enter), leading?, actions?, onCopy?, onCopyError?) from "@/components/ui/copy-field": secrets / webhook / invite codes; clipboard with execCommand fallback then select-for-manual-copy; native copy of a masked value yields the real value; masked dots shrink to keep maskPeek visible; multiline auto height (field-sizing with JS fallback); label wraps in Field, reads Field context; copyToClipboard, maskValue exported
- VirtualList<T>(items, getKey, renderItem, estimateSize=48|(item,i)=>n, overscan=6, gap=0, reverse=false, followOutput=reverse, followThreshold=64, scrollBehavior, onStartReached/startThreshold, onEndReached/endThreshold, onUnseenChange, onAtBottomChange, onRangeChange, scrollParent="self"|"scroll-area"|RefObject, header, footer, empty, ref) from "@/components/ui/virtual-list": zero-dep, variable heights measured by ResizeObserver and cached by key, translateY rows; reverse chat mode follows only at bottom, prepend keeps position via key anchor; handle scrollToIndex/scrollToKey(target, {align, behavior}) -> Promise<boolean>, scrollToBottom, scrollToTop, isAtBottom, getUnseen, getRange, measure; reverse mode bottom-aligns inside ScrollArea too; onStartReached/onEndReached may return a Promise and auto-continue until the viewport is filled; touch momentum never interrupted (corrections deferred to scroll end); prepends sub-pixel exact
- ResizablePanelGroup(direction="horizontal"|"vertical", autoSaveId? (re-read on change, cross-tab sync), storage?, layout? (strictly controlled, bounces back), onLayout?(sizes), keyboardStep=2, animation=true|ms|false (200ms), groupRef {getLayout, setLayout(sizes, animate), reset}) / ResizablePanel(defaultSize, minSize, maxSize: number(%)|"240px", collapsible, collapsedSize=0, onCollapse, onExpand, onResize, panelRef) / ResizableHandle(withHandle?, disabled?, hitArea=8) from "@/components/ui/resizable": zero-dep split panes; VS Code-style cascading push; drag via pointer capture + rAF writes flexGrow (no child re-render); rAF-animated collapse / expand / reset; snap-collapse below half min, double-click resets, ARIA separator keys; localStorage "hx-resizable:<id>"; resizeAt / resizePair exported
- Dropzone(variant="overlay"|"area", accept?, multiple=true, maxSize?, minSize?, maxFiles?, count?, onFiles(files, source), onReject(files, reasons), paste?: boolean|"window", tone, overlay?, hint?, blur=true, duration=180, size, ref {open()}) from "@/components/ui/dropzone" + UploadList(items: {id, name, size, type?, status: "queued"|"uploading"|"paused"|"done"|"error", progress?, error?, preview?}[], density, animation, thumbnail=true, onPause/onResume/onCancel/onRetry/onRemove) from "@/components/ui/upload-list": drag-in overlay (counter-based, no flicker) or upload card; validates and emits only, no upload; formatBytes / validateFiles / matchAccept exported
- ImageCropper(src: File|Blob|string, aspect=1|number|"free", cropShape="rect"|"round", grid, dragMode="auto"|..., zoom/defaultZoom/onZoomChange, minZoom=1, maxZoom=4, rotation/defaultRotation/onRotationChange (any angle), rotatable=true, restrict=true, padding=24, keyStep=10, onCropChange, onCropComplete, onError({code: "cors"|"network"|"http"|"decode", message}), ref) + ImageCropperStraighten (-45..45 straighten ruler) from "@/components/ui/image-cropper": drag pan, wheel / pinch zoom around pointer, free crop box edges / corners / move, fixed-aspect corner resize, exact cover constraint under rotation; keys arrows / + - / R / [ ] / 0; URL loading falls back crossOrigin -> fetch blob -> preview-only; handle getBlob({size, type, quality, round (default for cropShape round), background (default theme --background)}) / getCanvas / getArea / reset
- MentionInput(value?/defaultValue?/onValueChange?, triggers?: {char, items: MentionItem[] | (q)=>MentionItem[]|Promise, label?, startOfLine?, allowSpaces?, filter?, renderItem?, tone?}[] (default "@"), onMentionsChange?(ids, mentions), maxItems=8, highlight="text"|"background"|false (default text), placement="auto"|"bottom"|"top", anchor="trigger"|"caret", autoGrow=true, minRows=2, maxRows=8, debounce=150, renderItem?(item, {active, query, trigger, composing})) from "@/components/ui/mention-input": caret-anchored candidate popover with fade-out exit for @ / # / slash triggers, ↑↓ Enter/Tab Esc, IME live pinyin prefilter, inserts "@name " and tracks mention ids (undo / redo restores them), mention text tinted via scroll-locked overlay with native caret / selection, async sources
- ChipGroup(type="single"|"multiple", value?: string|null|string[], defaultValue, onValueChange(value, {all}), deselectable=false, all?, allCount?, variant="soft"|"outline"|"solid", size="sm"|"default", animation="slide"|"fade"|"none", duration=220, fade=true, fadeWidth=28, scrollButtons=false, wheel=true, zeroCount="dim"|"hide"|"show", countMax=999) + Chip(value, count?, icon?, disabled?) from "@/components/ui/chip-group": filter chips with count badges, horizontal scroll with edge fade only on the overflowing side, hidden scrollbar, selected chip scrolls into view, clip-path sliding indicator (radius never distorts), roving tabindex arrows / Home / End; "all" keyed by an internal symbol
- Marquee(duration?, gap?, reverse?, vertical?, pauseOnHover?, fade?) from "@/effects/marquee": 品牌墙 / 评价无缝滚动

## 视觉组件
- SplitText(text, as?, split?: "chars"|"words", effect?: "rise"|"fade"|"blur"|"flip"|"pop"|"skew"|"wave", from?: "start"|"center"|"end"|"random", ease?: "out"|"inOut"|"spring", stagger?, duration?, delay?, trigger?: "mount"|"inView", hover?: "none"|"lift"|"brand", loop?, loopDelay?, onComplete?): 文字拆成字或词逐段登场; 读屏读整句
- NumberRoll(value, mode?: "spring"|"digits", format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?, duration?, from?): spring 整体弹到目标值, digits 逐位滚动
- DecryptedText(text, as?, effect?: "scramble"|"flip"|"fade", animateOn?: "view"|"hover"|"inViewHover"|"click"|"manual", clickMode?: "once"|"toggle", speed?(ms), maxIterations?, sequential?, revealDirection?: "start"|"end"|"center"|"random", useOriginalCharsOnly?, characters?, hoverRadius?(px), loop?, loopDelay?(ms), scrambleColor?, parentClassName?, className?, encryptedClassName?, renderChar?, ref{play,scramble,reveal}, onComplete?): 乱码逐字破解成原文; 读屏读原文
- ScrollReveal(children, scrollContainerRef?, mode?: "scrub"|"enter", splitBy?: "words"|"chars"|"lines", effect?: "fade"|"rise"|"flip"|"scale", highlightColor?, stagger?, duration?, smoothing?, enableBlur?, blurStrength?, baseOpacity?, baseRotation?, baseOffset?, start?, end?, containerClassName?, textClassName?, pieceClassName?, onProgress?): 大字跟随滚动逐段亮起; 中文按字
- Aurora(colorStops?, amplitude?, blend?, height?, speed?, scale?, glow?, brightness?, layers?(1-3), direction?: "top"|"bottom", mouseInteraction?, intro?, opacity?, lightMode?, time?, paused?, dpr?, className?, canvasClassName?, children?): WebGL 极光背景; 颜色可用 var(--token)
- Particles(particleCount?, particleSpread?, speed?, particleColors?, particleBaseSize?, sizeRandomness?, shape?: "circle"|"square"|"ring"|"sparkle", glow?, twinkle?, depthOfField?, connections?, connectionDistance?, drift?: "none"|"up"|"down"|"forward", driftSpeed?, moveParticlesOnHover?, hoverEffect?: "parallax"|"repel"|"attract", particleHoverFactor?, hoverRadius?, clickBurst?, softParticles?, disableRotation?, cameraDistance?, variation?, intro?, opacity?, lightMode?, ref{burst}): 3D 粒子背景
- ClickSpark(sparkColor?: string|string[], shape?: "line"|"streak"|"dot"|"star", sparkCount?, sparkSize?, sparkWidth?, sparkRadius?, duration?, easing?, randomness?, gravity?, spread?, direction?, glow?, ring?, layer?: "front"|"back", extraScale?, disabled?, ref{spark}, children): 点击处迸火花, 键盘触发从元素中心
- ScrollStack(itemDistance?, itemStackDistance?, stackPosition?, itemScale?, baseScale?, dimAmount?, blurAmount?, tiltAmount?, rotationAmount?, holdDistance?, smoothScroll?, snap?, useWindowScroll?, onStackComplete?, className?, innerClassName?) + ScrollStackItem(itemClassName?, ...div): 滚动时卡片钉住叠放
- TiltCard(children, max?, scale?, glare?): 3D 倾斜 + 跟随指针的反光

## 工具 (不单列)
- Magnetic(strength?): 指针靠近时吸附; Backdrop(variant: "grid"|"dots"|"aurora"|"glow", size?): 区块底纹; 样式类 hx-grid, hx-dots, hx-noise

## 数据
- AreaTrend(data, x, series[{key, label, color?}], stacked?, height?), BarCompare(data, x, series, stacked?, horizontal?), Donut(data[{key, label, value}], centerLabel?), Sparkline(values), DataTable(data, columns: ColumnDef<T>[], searchable?, pageSize?, loading?, onRowClick?)

## 蓝图 (拓展包)
- 蓝图编辑器不在根入口和核心样式里, 按需引入: 逻辑 "@hx/ui/blueprint" (defineTypes, defineNode, createRegistry, toJSON/fromJSON, applyOps ...), 编辑器 "@hx/ui/blueprint/ui" (Blueprint, BlueprintWorkbench, useBlueprint), 面板 "@hx/ui/blueprint/panels", AI 工具 "@hx/ui/blueprint/agent", 调试 "@hx/ui/blueprint/debug". 源码路径 "@/blueprint", "@/blueprint/ui".
- 样式另引, 排在核心样式之后: 不用 Tailwind 引 "@hx/ui/blueprint/styles.css" (跟在 "@hx/ui/styles.css" 后); Tailwind v4 在 CSS 里 @import "@hx/ui/blueprint.css" (跟在 "@hx/ui/tailwind.css" 后).

## Agent 界面 (拓展包)

- 入口 "@hx/ui/agent" (不在根入口和核心样式里). 样式: 不用 Tailwind 引 "@hx/ui/agent/styles.css" (跟在 "@hx/ui/styles.css" 后); Tailwind v4 在 CSS 里 @import "@hx/ui/agent.css" (跟在 "@hx/ui/tailwind.css" 后). 源码路径 "@/agent".
- Markdown: 流式 Markdown. <Markdown streaming={generating} fences={...} plugins={{ math }}>{text}</Markdown>. 未闭合语法补全, 只重渲染最后一块, 末尾光标. 围栏 meta: title="a.ts", {1,3-5} 行高亮, startLine=10, collapse=20, showLineNumbers=false, [组名-标签] 相邻同组合成选项卡.
- 围栏渲染器: fences={{ lang: Comp }}, Comp 拿到 { code, lang, meta, incomplete, theme }. 内置 svg (清洗后预览); HtmlFence 需显式注册; Mermaid 从 "@hx/ui/agent/mermaid" 引 mermaidFences (需装 mermaid); 公式从 "@hx/ui/agent/math" 引 math 插件与 mathFences (需装 @streamdown/math katex, 引 katex/dist/katex.min.css).
- CodeBlock: 博客同款代码块, One Dark Pro, 行号, 复制 / 换行 / 下载. 属性 code, language, title, theme ("dark" | "auto"), lineNumbers, startLine, highlightLines, collapse, maxHeight, wrap, incomplete, actions.
- Reasoning: 思考过程, 生成中计时并显示最新一行, 结束收成 "已思考 N 秒".
- ToolCall: 工具调用, status 为 preparing | awaiting-approval | running | success | error | interrupted | denied. 按工具名找视图 (defaultToolViews 内置 bash, read_file, write_file, edit, apply_patch, grep, glob, web_fetch, web_search, todo_write, ask_user_question, task ...), 未注册走通用 IN / OUT. 自定义 ToolView: { kind, icon, title(call), summary(call), suffix(call), Body, defaultOpen(call), pinned(call) }.
- AgentProvider: toolViews, actions ({ onApprove, onDeny, onAnswer, onOpenFile, onOpenUrl, onInspect }), cwd, markdown (Markdown 默认设置), mode ("grouped" | "flat" | "hide-success" | "zen").
- AgentParts / ActivityGroup: 一条消息的 parts; 连续的思考和工具调用折成 "已处理 8 秒 · 修改了 2 个文件, 运行了 3 条命令".
- 会话: Conversation (贴底跟随, footer 放输入框), MessageList (messages, onRetry, onEdit), UserMessage, AssistantMessage, PromptInput (onSubmit(text, files), busy, onStop, commands, mentions, toolbar, status), WorkingIndicator, ContextMeter, UsageSummary.
- 数据: AgentMessage { id, role, parts, status, usage }, AgentPart = text | reasoning | tool | notice | file. useAgentStream() -> { messages, push(event), busy }; 事件 message-start, text-delta, reasoning-delta, tool-start, tool-args-delta, tool-args, tool-status, tool-output-delta, tool-result, tool-child, notice, usage, message-end. reduceAgentEvents 是纯函数. fromAiSdkMessages 适配 Vercel AI SDK 的 UIMessage.

## 主题
- 包 `ThemeProvider`; `useTheme()` 返回 { mode, resolved, accent, setMode, setAccent }; 强调色 indigo | emerald | rose | amber | zinc | ink (ink 连中性色一起换, ChatGPT 式). 非 Web 端用 `@hx/ui/tokens.json` 与 `@hx/ui/components.json`.
- 令牌: background, foreground, card, muted, accent, primary, brand, brand-soft, success, warning, destructive, info, chart-1..5, border, ring.

## 示例
每个组件的演示和调参在文档站 site/src/docs/entries/<slug>.demo.tsx.
- Scatter3D(points: {id,x,y,z,group?,size?,label?}[], xLabel, yLabel, zLabel (height), format?(v, axis), stems=true, autoRotate) lazy three.js, points keyed by id (enter scale-in, exit scale-out, move lerp) ; Map3D(data: {name,value}[] (province full/short name), metric, format, labelTop=5, autoRotate) extruded China provinces, keyed by name, missing data = flat grey
